name: transformers
description: 🤗 Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models in text, vision, audio, and multimodal models, for both inference and training.
one_liner: The foundational free toolkit that most modern AI models (for text, images, and audio) are built and run on — it's the engine under the hood of countless AI products, not a product itself.
buyer: No single specific buyer — it's core infrastructure that engineering teams use to build other products, not something a business pays for directly.
business_use_cases: A consultancy offers paid training or implementation services helping companies adopt it for their own ML pipelines.
A startup fine-tunes one specific model on it to build a narrow product (e.g. a contract-clause classifier) and sells that product.
An AI trainer runs paid workshops teaching engineering teams how to use it effectively.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid implementation/training consulting to companies adopting it for their ML stack.

steal_this: This isn't a weekend business on its own — it's the plumbing. Pick one narrow, specific model built on top of it and turn *that* into a product instead.
